lines.para: Born in 1918 from the ruins of Austria-Hungary, the kingdom unites Serbs, Croats and Slovenes under a single crown. In 1934, King Alexander I is assassinated in Marseille. His cousin, Prince Paul, rules as regent over a divided country, wedged between Mussolini’s Italy and Hitler’s Germany.
On the coast, Dubrovnik still lives to the rhythm of yachts and balls. The great families spend their summers there as if Europe would never tip over.
